/*
  Learning file: one example per Tailwind v4 theme namespace (variable -> utility).
  Active rules are safe additions or restrictions that match nothing the app uses today.
  Commented rules show a risky override; the note says what it changes.
  Tailwind emits a theme variable only when a utility or var() uses it, so unused tokens cost nothing.
*/

/* ---------- Mechanisms ---------- */

/*
  Last declaration wins: re-declaring a default variable replaces it.
  `--x: initial` removes one variable, `--ns-*: initial` removes a namespace, `--*: initial` removes the whole default theme.
  Removed tokens do not error: their utilities just stop being generated.
*/

/* @theme static { ... }   always emit the variables, even when unused (e.g. for JS or runtime var() reads) */
/* @theme default { ... }  marks values as overridable defaults; for shared libraries, not for apps */

@theme {
  /* --color-*: unset; */
  /* --color-*: initial; */

  --color-brand: oklch(0.55 0.2 275);
}

}
